hypothesis: The active V58 SPCX route is technically unavailable because its exact public-trade builder demands irrelevant all-hours 15-minute continuity. A scheduled cash-session source can restore evaluation without changing the strategy if it recognizes combined-channel gaps, preserves per-bar gap provenance, and fails closed whenever the current opening bar or immediately prior cash close is unresolved.
decision: Request approval to implement and validate the repair in report-only mode. Do not change the active V58 runtime. Live cutover requires complete strategy and exit parity, required-bar fail-closed tests, collector no-advance tests, one report-only forward cash-open observation, full suite verification, and a separate reconciled restart approval.
falsifier: Reject or redesign the candidate if a scheduled-session source changes any complete-window signal, target anchor, stop, exit, or decision time; if a current opening or prior-close gap can reach an eligible entry; if overnight no-advance creates duplicate or stale decisions; if the next forward cash-open remains unavailable for a different technical reason; or if source provenance cannot distinguish websocket and independently acquired trades.
limitations: The repair is not implemented and has no forward cash-open observation.
OHLC invariance was established for one affected opening bar, not every possible future disconnect.
The exact source-provenance model for independently acquired gap trades remains to be designed and tested.
The 2.62-hour quiet prefix is too short to infer route profitability or long-run frequency.
Restoring technical availability does not qualify the strategy's live economics.
